clue.text: Take issue with attitude after work

explanation.surface: Someone objecting to a colleague's manner once the job is done.
explanation.definitionFit: To oppose something is to resist or object to it, which is exactly taking issue.

clue.text: Bottle packer's first chance

clue.text: Missile may see former officer commanding Egypt after evacuation

clue.text: Alternative reality tribe captures noisy intruder with diamonds

clue.text: Games slimy cop plays

taken as written

parts.note: the three words supply the letters to be rearranged

clue.text: Shame London perhaps needs to replace leader

clue.text: Effort by friend is not worth considering

clue.text: Scoff and criticise raising charge to support British

clue.text: In France a public space that's rarely seen

parts.note: un is French for 'a'

clue.text: Doubt Monsieur is generous

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for the French title Monsieur
taken as written
giving means generous

clue.text: Special forces hospital band

clue.text: Link from embassy official cut

clue.text: Summarises unavailable approaches

lines as in lines of approach or methods

clue.text: Split career

clue.text: Understand synopsis

second meaning: a summary or compendium

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means taking in information mentally; as a noun it is a condensed summary.
